findings.desc: Recovery smoke does not fully prove the operator-visible cleanup transcript promised by CHK-004. Fresh run of npm --prefix packages/main run test:worktree-repair-smoke passes, but the recovery assertion only checks "partial-DONE recovered" and "story/<id> merged into main" in packages/main/src/tasks/worktree-repair-smoke.ts:225-227. The command output also promises worktree-removal and branch-deletion lines from packages/main/src/core/partial-done-recovery.ts:185-197 and packages/main/src/handlers/done-recover.ts:75-77, yet the smoke covers those only via final git/fs state at lines 229-235. This leaves the must intent for operator-visible recovery output under-proved.
